scope: Organism-independent synthetic regression of selective FASTQ abstention. Development fixtures, not independent held-out validation or a real-cohort concordance study.

method.inputs: Updated workers rerun after reconstruction-conflict fixes on exactly the earlier retained inputs and arguments except output destination. Unchanged baseline measurements are reused from the per-run baseline_report_reused. Hashes also match the original frozen-baseline fixtures.
method.reconstruction_conflicts: Finalizer rejects disagreement with derived microassembly evidence; shared reconstruction handling records disagreement for every supported product method.
method.coverage: Copies change synthetic molecule multiplicity and seeded error realizations. This is a depth/error sensitivity sweep, not nested genomic downsampling; outcomes need not be monotonic.
method.timing: Concurrent test activity was possible. No performance claim; timings omitted here and retained in raw reports.
method.policy: Primary counts now require accepted sample evidence; rejected numerical proposals remain diagnostic. The long-read default minimum depth changes from 1 to 3; the short-read default remains 3.

definitions.call_rate: Numeric primary calls / all truth-known loci; abstentions remain in the denominator.
definitions.accuracy_among_calls: Exact primary calls / numeric primary calls at truth-known loci.
definitions.exact_accuracy_all_truth_known: Exact primary calls / all truth-known loci.
definitions.mixtures: Either known mixture allele counts as numerically correct. Withholding such a prediction need not be an undesirable decision.
definitions.absence: The absent locus has no allele truth, is excluded from accuracy denominators, and remains in per-locus records.
definitions.database_file_manifest: SHA256 of JSON mapping every relative database filename to its file SHA256, with sort_keys=True.

post_snapshot_note: Original metrics and source hashes above describe the frozen acceptance-policy snapshot. Final workspace changes and fresh replay results are recorded below; original measurements are preserved.
limitations: No real FASTQ/assembly cohort, held-out isolates, pairwise isolate-distance correlation, or independently calibrated probability was evaluated.
Observed accepted-call accuracy on this small development fixture is not a production accuracy estimate.
Abstention removes correct predictions as well as wrong ones; correct calls across all truth-known loci decrease despite higher accuracy among accepted calls.
The four-copy noisy paired fixture informed development of the empirical-agreement gate and is not independent validation of that gate.
Changed callability changes distance overlap; these results do not establish improved strain-typing concordance or nearest-neighbor preservation.
Temporary retained directories may be removed by the operating system. This record preserves metrics, per-locus outcomes and hashes, not full FASTQ inputs.

final_workspace_validation.method: Serial fresh-process replay of the frozen accuracy inputs after panel recruitment, consensus-depth and export fixes; one trial per configuration, no runtime claim.
